# graphql-orm-client

A GraphQL client for graphql-orm APIs: fragments colocated with components, compiled route
queries, a normalised store and live updates from generated Changed subscriptions. Status:
design stage; APIs in these documents are proposals. Read the installed docs, which match the
installed version.

- [README](README.md)
- [Design](docs/design.md)
- [graphql-orm contract](docs/graphql-orm-contract.md)
- [Roadmap](docs/roadmap.md)
- [Contributor guidance](AGENTS.md)
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)
- Skills: skills/graphql-orm-client-adopt, skills/graphql-orm-client-data,
  skills/graphql-orm-client-live, skills/graphql-orm-client-server
